label: Multimorbidity in Chronic Overlapping Pain Conditions: From Burden to Integrated Care.
summary: Chronic overlapping pain conditions (COPCs) refer to a set of chronic pain disorders that frequently co-occur and may involve partially overlapping mechanisms. The U.S. National Institutes of Health currently recognizes ten COPCs: fibromyalgia, painful temporomandibular disorders, chronic low back pain, chronic migraine headache, chronic tension-type headache, irritable bowel syndrome, endometriosis, interstitial cystitis/bladder pain syndrome, vulvodynia, and myalgic encephalomyelitis/chronic…
